territories.name: The Counted Word
territories.idea: Counting is the one thing Mindgut does to your words that anyone can check. Every letter becomes a digit and one of three channels. Make the identity out of that act: type that carries its own arithmetic.
formula: Show only counts the page computed from text it can see.
One count per headline. Never a dashboard of them.
Channels are names, not meanings.
Tone comes from how many digits print, never from a gradient.
possibilities: A live count under the composer
Headline lockups that carry their own scan
Receipts and tickets printed from a session
Wordmark rendered as counted digits for motion idents
territories.strong: The most ownable idea in the archive: it is the mechanism, so it cannot survive a logo swap. W-landing V01’s blue counted field is the best execution so far.
territories.develop: Decide the register: quiet ledger (chips, tabular numerals) or loud specimen board (“SAY IT ONCE”). Both exist; they need a rule for when each appears.
territories.abandon: Any line that implies channels carry meaning. HUDs full of triples (the Island experience). Digits sprinkled on images that were never counted.
dna: KEPT :: 21 — label, two colons, a number
relations: the count is the first receipt

territories.name: River and Riverbed
territories.idea: The product’s clearest sentence and its best diagram: models are the river, your record is the riverbed. Change the model; the bed stays where it is.
formula: Pair motion with something that holds still.
Show the swap as an event in time, not a menu.
The bed is drawn from the record’s real counts.
One water metaphor per page.
possibilities: Launch film: one bed, three rivers
Outdoor line: “Change the model. The bed stays where it is.”
territories.strong: The copy line is the strongest in the archive and every lineage reached it independently. The illustrated river in Said and Kept is the one image that makes it memorable.
territories.develop: Most executions are dark dashboards with too many readouts; draw the riverbed as a place (landscape, section, map) instead.
territories.abandon: “Every AI you use is an island” stacked on top of “river” and “water.” Keep river and riverbed; drop the island.
dna: A moving thing beside a thing that stays
swaps shown as a cut in the flow
the breath that sets three exchanges into the spine
a ledger and an email in one field
the river as a place, not a chart
relations: the bed is made of counts
worlds are different banks of the same river
the app is where the swap happens

territories.name: One Object, Two Views
territories.idea: The Reflection mark and the Standing Wave are one record seen from above and from the side. The mark is not a drawing of the product; it is a projection of your own record. “A reflection only you could make.”
formula: One object; every view must be a true projection.
Change views by rotating, never by cutting.
Earn the complexity: one dot, two threads, a breath, a turn.
No two marks alike, because no two records are.
possibilities: A mark minted from each person’s first 42 crossings
The tilt as the motion ident on every surface
Lenticular print: 0° from one side, 90° from the other
territories.strong: The week’s central discovery, named in the Fable 5.2 brief and drawn by four makers. The spiral stair in Reflection Identity is the breakthrough image: it shows the tilt halfway and gives the object a scale.
territories.develop: The radial bloom alone reads as a generic burst; it needs the stair or the side view beside it. The kit’s palette and the green Reflection pages disagree.
territories.abandon: Starbursts drawn all at once on load. Glows that stand in for structure.
relations: the figure on the stair gives scale

territories.name: The Specimen
territories.idea: Mir documented as an imaginary organism with natural-history care. The Io moth’s two eyespots are the two voices; each collaboration grows a different moth. Labeled where the metaphor stops: borrowed from life, not a claim about life.
formula: Real anatomy, drawn and labeled.
Every plate answers the pointer.
The metaphor ends at a written line.
The specimen is Mir’s, never the product’s.
possibilities: Mir’s notebook: research and field notes
A specimen plate per person’s record
territories.strong: The highest craft per square inch in the archive: the moth plates answer the pointer and hold up at 1:1.
territories.develop: It competes with the robot for who Mir is, and the brief warns that growth and nature are not the default explanation for memory. Keep the eyespots-as-two-voices idea; place the rest in Mir’s own voice.
territories.abandon: The moth as the master identity or the product hero.
dna: tone built from many small marks
what the metaphor does not claim
relations: two characters, one needs to yield

territories.name: The Press
territories.idea: The record is printed, not rendered: ink, graphite, foil, deboss, varnish and laser on lit paper. One stock, one light, real material behavior instead of gradients.
formula: One stock and one light per sheet.
The material changes how a mark lands, never where.
Small type stays outside the press.
Print where print can be held.
possibilities: Foil and deboss of a person’s mark
A printed specimen of the first 42 crossings
territories.strong: Genuinely computed material, from Julia’s own T-04 lineage, and the clearest answer to “no AI gradients.”
territories.develop: Applied to web pages (Three Directions) it reads as texture at screen scale. Its home is objects and specimens.
territories.abandon: Stacking effects to add richness. Print physics on body copy.
dna: ink as a film, not a color

territories.name: Worlds
territories.idea: Personal software through ways of knowing. A skin changes how Mindgut looks, never what it does; each world is borrowed from a working practice and runs on the same record.
formula: One record, one rule per world.
A world must change how you find something.
Same data, different material.
Fewer worlds, deeper.
possibilities: Launch content: one week per world
territories.strong: Three makers converged on worlds without coordinating; that is a signal. V08’s system sheets with an app screen per skin are the mature form.
territories.develop: Seven is too many to make deep. Choose three or four and have each change retrieval (catalog, timeline, map), not only color.
territories.abandon: Illustrated scenes that only decorate (V01). The Gardener as default, per the brief.
dna: Gardener, Navigator, Weaver, Astronomer, Composer, Printer, Archivist
the same seven entries in every world

territories.name: The Instrument
territories.idea: Mindgut is played, not dispensed: the conversation in front, the workings within reach, and marks that keep a model’s suggestion from passing as your decision.
formula: Precise chrome, one living body.
Every state has a mark.
Proposals are labeled as proposals.
Interface at usable scale.
territories.strong: The docs and the coded app rebuilds are credible and specific. The eight marks are the most underused idea in the archive.
territories.develop: Bring the marks into the app and the marketing; make the fluid body a presence indicator only.
territories.abandon: Knobs and meters that report nothing (brief).
dna: the fluid presence in a precise frame
relations: marks are receipts in the UI

territories.name: Receipts
territories.idea: Honesty as a visual language: every claim carries its source, its denominator and its status. In a field full of unverifiable AI claims, showing the arithmetic is the distinctive position.
formula: A number never appears without its denominator.
Status is a visible state, not a footnote.
Simulated data says so on the surface.
Headlines are held to the evidence.
possibilities: “Field Note from the Lab” social spine
territories.strong: The most culturally intelligent territory and already practiced: the dossier keeps every denominator; the record plates use real counts.
territories.develop: The case-study headlines (“only one checked its own work”) claim more than reported, uncontrolled comparisons support. The discipline has to reach the headline.
territories.abandon: Precision as decoration: four decimals with no method.

territories.name: The Witness
territories.idea: The supplied robot as the figure that shows where you stand: at the eye point of the anamorphic room, on the stair, in the parade. A witness at signature scale, not a mascot that talks.
formula: One robot per composition.
Put it where the viewer’s eye would be.
It acts; it does not explain.
territories.strong: Charming and specific; the parade proves the character can move.
territories.develop: Three figures are in use (the supplied robot, the kit’s illustrated version, a red walker). D-004 still has “robot kept vs discarded” open.
territories.abandon: Talking-mascot copy. A new character beside the supplied one.
dna: robots, dogs, a cat, a chicken

before_after.what: Cyanotype surface rejected: “too blue / blueprinty / watercolory.” Fraunces banned. Structure kept; near-black instrument ground and one lamp accent.
Seventy minutes apart: dashboard panels around a glowing chord become a field guide with one specimen, the Io moth, and a plain sentence.
An illustrated loom becomes a working rule: your words are the warp, Mir’s are the weft. Each world gains an app screen and a system sheet.
The same page reprinted through the T-04 engine: one blue, brushed, on paper. “What was said is not here.”
Letters weighted by channel give way to one weight of Geist with count chips beneath: KEPT :: 21. Restraint won.
The counted blue field gives way to the riverbed on near-black. V02 was still landing while this was assembled.
A three-spread memo becomes a 28-page visual anatomy with ten explanatory diagrams and the numerical ledger.

opportunities.next: One launch page, one film script, one outdoor line, all river/riverbed.

open_decisions.question: Palette, type, robot: plum + green-teal vs black + violet; Archivo vs Montserrat (now also Geist); robot kept vs discarded.
Recall: the 2.2.58 spec (involuntary 1+3+3 every turn) vs “What Mir Is” (voluntary, hidden). Governs every recall drawing.
Nine grounds in eight days, sampled from the pages: Klein blue, near-black, Void, sage, forest and lime, mint, Reflection green, deep green and white. Pick one ground and one signal.
Two landing lineages ran in parallel on 12 Nov (W-landing V02 in Claude/, front door V07 in Ø). Which continues?

Two English baselines are in code: μ = (0.302, 0.351, 0.347) in record-system.ts and the Fable brief; E0 = (0.282, 0.394, 0.324) in W-landing’s core.js. Every Δ and every radius depends on which one is right.
The team thread planned launch week for 16 Nov. Which of these pieces is the launch surface?
